events.title: Demo 1.0.4: voice control understands you even better
events.summary: We keep going! I went through every voice phrase that failed and every report from this week, and 1.0.4 is the result. Voice control Understands many more real phrases: "maintain present altitude", "continue approach", "proceed to", spelled-out fixes, and the callsign said at the end of the instruction. events.title: Demo 1.0.3: pick your microphone, and voice control understands you better
events.summary: Thanks to everyone playing the demo during Next Fest! I've read every survey, bug report and voice phrase you sent, and 1.0.3 comes straight from them. Microphone setting New in Settings > Audio: choose which microphone voice control uses. TEST MICROPHONE button: it listens for 5 seconds, shows the live level and the phrase it understood, so you know the game hears you before your shift starts.
